profileLabel: Center-left economics; liberal on social values and civil liberties (medium confidence)
summary: Albay 1st District representative with 57 principal-authored bills. Authored absolute divorce, property rights for same-sex couples, adolescent pregnancy prevention, rights of human rights defenders, a certificate of enforced disappearance for victims' families, compassionate early release of qualified detainees, the national minimum wage, fisherfolk tenure and benefits, occupational safety and limits on children's unhealthy food marketing.
caveat: Scores rest on authored bills and no votes or statements. Scored +3 rather than higher because demonstrated conduct was not reviewed. Smoke-free and vape-free bill treated as health regulation, not scored. Facebook URL in input is dead.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored the national minimum wage and climate-adaptive occupational safety (-2, labor), fisherfolk tenure and benefits (-2, social provision) and limits on children's unhealthy food marketing (-2, regulation).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08081, HB10559, HB09044, HB06065 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Authored absolute divorce (+4), property rights for same-sex couples (+4) and adolescent pregnancy prevention with protection for adolescent parents (+3). Capped at +3 pending reviewed conduct.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00655, HB08385, HB00654 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Protective-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored rights and freedoms of human rights defenders (+4), certificates of enforced disappearance for victims' families (+3) and compassionate early release for qualified detainees (+2). Bills only.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00656, HB00943, HB11581 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Insufficient evidence
democratic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
